Why go algorithmic?

Automation removes emotion, enables scale, and gives you a measurable edge over discretionary trading.

Algorithmic trading transforms the way you interact with markets. By codifying your strategy into a set of deterministic rules, you eliminate the emotional and cognitive biases that often lead to sub‑optimal decisions. Whether you are a hedge fund, a proprietary trading firm, or an individual quant, the ability to backtest, optimise, and execute systematically gives you a measurable edge.

  • Eliminate emotional trading – stick to your plan without hesitation.
  • Backtest and validate your ideas against decades of historical data.
  • Scale your strategy across thousands of instruments without additional headcount.
  • Receive real‑time performance analytics and risk alerts.

The reality: strategy is easy, execution is hard

Most traders have great ideas. The bottleneck is turning them into a reliable, production‑ready system.

Fragmented data, slow backtesting, disconnected tools, and execution latency are the silent killers of alpha. Even the best strategy will fail if it takes days to test a new parameter, or if your orders are filled at stale prices. Our platform addresses each of these pain points head‑on.

  1. Fragmented data: We unify price feeds, fundamentals, sentiment, and alternative data into a single, consistent stream.
  2. Manual backtesting: Our engine runs multi‑asset, multi‑timeframe simulations with realistic slippage and fees in seconds, not hours.
  3. Siloed tools: Research, development, and execution live in one environment – no more copy‑pasting between systems.
  4. Delayed execution: Our low‑latency infrastructure ensures your orders reach the exchange in under 10ms.

Case study: Doubling Sharpe ratio

How we helped a $500M hedge fund transform its trading outcomes.

A $500M hedge fund was struggling with inconsistent returns and high turnover. Their manual backtesting process took days, and they often missed profitable signals due to outdated data. We migrated their entire workflow to our platform:

  • Data integration: Connected to 10+ data providers for equities and options.
  • Backtesting: Reduced backtest time from 5 days to 2 hours, enabling rapid iteration.
  • Optimisation: Used our machine learning tools to fine‑tune parameters and reduce drawdown.
  • Execution: Deployed to their existing MT4 setup with our low‑latency bridge.

Results: Within 3 months, their Sharpe ratio increased from 1.2 to 2.5, turnover dropped by 40%, and they saved over $200,000 in manual labour costs annually.
